body.query: How much did Hadrian raise in its latest funding round?

results.title: Hadrian Raises $1.37B Series D to Build Highly Automated Factories to Accelerate America's Industrial Renewal
results.author: Hadrian
highlights:
TORRANCE, Calif., Aug. 6, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hadrian, the advanced manufacturing company building highly automated factories for America, today announced $1.37 billion in new equity financing to accelerate the buildout of the domestic manufacturing capacity needed to deliver America's most critical defense, aerospace, and industrial systems.
...
The raise values Hadrian at $7.87 billion. The financing will be co-led by WCM Investment Management, Washington Harbour Partners, Valor Equity Partners, 137 Ventures, and Baillie Gifford.

# Defense Startup Hadrian Valued at $7.87 Billion in New Round
...
Hadrian, a defense manufacturing startup that serves the Pentagon, Lockheed Martin Corp. and others, secured a $7.87 billion valuation in a funding round that will help the company expand its workforce.
...
JPMorgan Chase & Co.’s Strategic Investment Group anchored the $1.37 billion Series D round, according to a statement Thursday. Valor Equity Partners and Baillie Gifford also participated in the financing deal, along with investors including Founders Fund, Andreessen Horowitz, and 1789 Capital, where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner.
